channel.title: L.D.everything
channel.description:
对于在小城出生长大的我们，很难在一个城市长大、求学、工作和生活，所以任何关系和事件，都会在自主选择和无法控制的波动中，成为所谓的“long distance”。
来到一个全新的陌生城市，一次次地或主动或被动迎来新生活，几乎是一个无法避免的课题。
尤其近年来，搬迁似乎意味着更多，城市间的流动性大大降低，旅行的成本变得不可估算，“说走就走”已经渐渐不再成为一个可选项。
而我似乎早已困于异地生活中，并且找到与之共处的小乐趣。
想在播客记录下一些生活碎片，既然来都来了，认识一下吧～
节目已同步小宇宙，Spotify（https://open.spotify.com/show/6OlsYjYdqeZLWIlglW0lmw）和QQ音乐（Podcast审核中），欢迎大家评分与分享！

item.title: Ep#14 A thirsty industry—Fashion
item.description:
Hey how is it going?

这期播客接着第2期播客“ 理财101—那就记账吧 ”里的一个小话题继续聊，从可持续性与环保的角度来聊聊时尚业/纺织服装业。

Timeline：

00:13-01:37 第2期播客小话题回顾：T恤的购买选择

01:38-02:22 Why THIRSTY? 博文link: www.sustainably-chic.com.

02:23-03:05 时尚业环境问题的讨论难以在大众舆论中存活

03:05-05:04 以科研出发浅讨论“叙事”角度，希望大家能对此期播客内容作出自己的判断

05:05-05:55 本期播客中：时尚业≈纺织服装业，博文link：fashion2apparel.com

主体内容分为以下3个方面：水、棉、消费。

水：05:56-13:16

1/ 耗水量：年度超过79万亿升

2/ 废水量：年度超过71万亿升

3/ 对比行业：啤酒业

4/ 废水处置比例及成本

5/ 洗衣服造成的海洋白色污染与塑料袋不相上下

棉：13:17-20:45

1/ 棉产量不高，但是所需农药占总农药使用的1/4

2/ 棉种植耗水量高，并且每单位面积土地产量较低

3/ 棉种植对劳力需求高

4/ 转基因棉花带来的人祸

5/ 有机棉也不是解决问题的答案

6/ 棉花经济秩序让每个人深陷其中

消费：20:46-25:50

1/ “Consumptionism is all about getting people to treat the things they use as the things they use up. ”（消费主义就是让人们把可以长期使用的东西当作消耗品。）

2/ 旧衣回收也不是一个完美答案

3/ 少买、多穿、以二手或交换代替购买新衣服，以更理性的消费才能等来真正的变化

25:51-27:29 再多聊几句以及下期再见👋

/后记/

其实kpop能聊的还有太多内容，一是能力有限，二是确实已经做累了(?)，所以就呈现出这样一期节目。

追kpop的这几年里，kpop给我带来的不仅仅是无数好听的歌曲，而且开启了我的对商业、政治、文化的好奇心。毫不夸张地说，了解与关注kpop已经成为了我生活的一部分。

饭圈通常以女性为主，饭圈女孩们也是一群不被大众所理解的群体。节目时间有限，没能谈到饭圈文化。其实饭圈文化与粉丝所在国家的文化也息息相关，每个饭圈都十分独特。中国饭圈高度的组织性与纪律性，也和中国女孩无法参与政治的现实分不开，无处可去的政治热情，一股脑地倍投入饭圈战争中。

当大众批评饭圈女孩的种种作为时，这真的是她们的错吗？

每个人都会有自己的答案。

item.title: Ep#09 我妈退休后生了我
item.description:
春天到处都露出生机，清明在春天是不是也是因为，重生的美好是死亡最大的慰藉。

这期播客以“身边即世界”的狭小视角展开，来聊聊变老这个话题。

🎙️你会听到以下内容：

00:27 我妈四十多岁生了我，长大是认知的校准过程

02:28 同学爸爸的去世给我留下经年噩梦，直到噩梦落入现实

03:53 亲子关系与祖孙关系：亲情距离产生美，太近则有利益冲突

05:54 父母的初老期遇上我的青春期，只能各自应付

07:48 人是不会突然变老的，变老是一个漫长的过程，而年轻的状态才是稀有且珍惜的

10:32 变老是一件具体的事情，身心都会变老的

11:09 维基百科上关于文盲的数据：文盲率的定义是15岁以上不识字人的比例。

  • 1949年，文盲率是80%，而农村地区的比例是95%
  • 1964年，文盲率下降到了52%
  • 1977年，文盲率是25%，而青壮年中文盲比例是30-40%
  • 2015年，中国的文盲率已经下降到了3.6%

11:53 在父母辈的文盲率为75%的家庭里，受教育的机会是我人生最大的幸运之一

13:29 不识字的老人们的被沉默里，还有很多未知的不幸

13:48 杨苡100年的人生被写成了书，我妈妈的人生却已经被遗忘

15:28 大多数人会先变老再离开

item.title: Ep#03 「基本演绎法」Detection is a calling
item.description:
hello，大家好！

这期是一部美剧的安利～

这部美剧就是美版的福尔摩斯，「基本演绎法」，2012年CBS出品，在2019年完结，共有7季154集，由John Miller和刘玉玲Lucy Liu主演，这无疑是我最爱的美剧，如果以后有朋友剧荒让我推荐美剧，我就把这期播客甩过去！

这期结束的音乐节选自基本演绎法的OP。

下期再见哟👋

📖quote的台词如下：

10:13

I wanted to thank you.

Don't.

I wanted to thank you everything you've done for me over the last six years.

Sherlock…

I was dying when we first met. I mean, I looked well enough. Just got out of rehab and all that. Thought that I knew everything, but I didn't. I didn't realize how much...how much work I would have to put in and how much time it would take. But most of all, I didn't realize that ... things could get better. And that I could actually be... Yes, I was dying. And no one can see it but you. You saved my life, Joan.

We're partners.

No, we're much better than that.

We're two people that love each other.

We always have been.

14:42

It has its costs.

What does?

Learning to see the puzzle in everything. They're everywhere. Once you start looking, it's impossible to stop. It just so happens that people and all the deceits and delusions that inform everything they do, tend to be the most fascinating puzzles of all. Of course, they don't always appreciate being seen as such.

Seems like a lonely way to live.

As I said, it has its costs.

16:30

I must say Watson, I enjoyed catching a glimpse of you I your former element. Seems to me your friend was right. You were quite a doctor.

I had my moments.

Maybe you'll give it another go one of these days.

18:12

I guess I shouldn't be surprised. I mean, none of us even knew he was separated until tonight.

I knew. Had my suspicions, anyway.He's been arriving earlier in the morning, leaving later, stopped bringing home-packed lunches.

Well, if you knew, then why didn't you say something to him?

Well, why would I?His work hasn't suffered. If anything, he's been slightly more focused. Quite frankly, I'm surprised it's taken this long for the Captain's marriage to buckle. He's an excellent detective.

What does that have to do with it?

Well, as you know, detection is a calling, not a job. Hardly leaves one with time left over to sustain the elaborate ruse of marriage.

Because, of course, you think marriage is an elaborate ruse.

21:43

I know you think that I don't like your new career.

To put it mildly.

You're right, I don't like it.

But not for the reasons that you think.

I'm not happy that you're a sober companion

because it never seems to make you happy.

How do you know what makes me happy?

I know because you're my daughter.

After you left medicine, after what happened with Liam（Watson前任）,

I've always thought that this job

was something that you picked out of...

I don't know, out of a sense of duty.

When you came to dinner the other night,

when the two of you talked about Sherlock's work,

I saw something in you.

There was a spark.

A sense of excitement.

I haven't seen that in you in a long time.

You like what he does.

Yes, okay, I enjoy it.

But I'm not a detective, Mom.

And I'm almost done working with Sherlock,

and then it's on to another client.

Will the next client make you happy?

People find their paths in the strangest of ways.

23:39

Why do you suppose you hate your job so much?

I don't hate my job.

You have two alarm clocks.

No one with two alarm clocks loves their job.

Two alarm clocks means it's a chore for you to get up in the morning.

You don't hate what I do though.

item.title: Ep#02 理财101—那就记账吧
item.description:
hello，大家好！

这期播客可能是最把「记账」当回事儿的节目了。

如果你还在疑惑记账很久了，却没有存到钱。那不如来听我絮叨一会，也许你会有新的思考和感受。

我一直认为独立的第一步是「经济独立」，走出第一步以后，才能真正的开始成年人生。现生的朋友应该都多多少少被我push过去存钱、去记账、去理财，这次也算是被反向push，干脆就整理成提纲以后，录成了这期播客。

由于我小特殊的经历，我已经记账15年了，可以说是「记账爱好者」了。记账给我带来的变化，不仅仅是更有规划地去消费，也让我在一次次的梳理中形成了自己的消费观与金钱观。

在理财这个课题里，还有无穷无尽的内容需要去学习，大家共勉。

【温馨提示】

本次播客中提到的任何内容，均基于个体的经验与学习。
